project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector
project.description:
Aggregator for the Google Calendar connector modules.
Follows the same hexagonal structure as bot-pilot-faqs: domain — Google-specific entities (GoogleCalendarCredentials JPA entity) application — use cases (depends on calendar-spi + domain) infrastructure-persistence — JPA + Spring Data adapter infrastructure-vault — Spring Cloud Vault AppRole adapter infrastructure-google-api — Google Calendar Java client adapter rest — Spring MVC driving adapter (OAuthController, CalendarController) app — Spring Boot assembler (composition root)
Build tiers (parallel with -T N): Tier 1 (parallel): domain [calendar-spi already built by parent aggregator] Tier 2 (parallel): application, infrastructure-persistence, infrastructure-vault, infrastructure-google-api Tier 3 (sequential): rest Tier 4 (sequential): app
